result.title: Do Visual RL Gains Scale at Test Time? A Quantile View of Post-Training
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the single-sample quality of visual generative models, but deployment often provides additional inference compute through Best-of-N sampling. Whether RL gains transfer under such test-time scaling, particularly on difficult held-out tasks, remains poorly understood in the visual domain. Our central contribution is to systematically identify and characterize a failure mode of scaling transfer in visual RL: across multiple RL methods, model backbones, and evaluations spanning compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, higher single-sample reward does not necessarily imply a better quality-compute frontier. RL gains may attenuate, saturate, or even reverse at large sampling budgets, with the base model eventually outperforming its post-trained counterpart. We explain these regimes through a quantile-transfer framework, showing that Best-of-N places increasing weight on the upper tail of the reward distribution as N grows. Consequently, RL can improve typical samples while compressing or degrading the rare high-quality outcomes that test-time scaling exploits. As a simple intervention motivated by this analysis, we introduce Quantile Utility Policy Optimization (QUPO), which optimizes a controllable mixture of quantile utilities corresponding to different inference budgets. Experiments on SD3.5-M and BAGEL show that QUPO better preserves upper-tail quality and substantially improves scaling on challenging held-out prompts relative to standard RL post-training. Our results suggest that visual generative models should be evaluated and optimized not only for single-sample quality, but for how post-training reshapes the full reward distribution that inference-time scaling exploits.

AI.brief_summary: 系统考察视觉生成模型经 RL 后训练后，其收益能否在 Best-of-N 测试时扩展下保持，并用分位迁移框架解释收益衰减、饱和甚至反转，进而提出 QUPO 优化多推理预算下的分位效用混合。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文虽面向图像生成，但其「单样本提升不等于质量-算力前沿提升」及奖励分布上尾压缩的分析视角，可能为核查 LVR 中训练收益与测试时扩展（如多轨迹采样加验证）之间的错位提供评价思路。
